name: PDF Tool
desc: PDF Tool: one-finger page flip for Arabic books (left-to-right = next page) in documents and notes, a one-screen PDF tool that stretches and centres the text, cleans the background, sharpens, darkens and straightens a PDF in place (with cancel and restore), a Text tool that formats a reflowable EPUB into a new copy, plus multi-finger file swipes.
author: Charles Cheval (modified)
